visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A woman with light brown hair and a white knit sweater stands in a brightly lit indoor room, speaking directly to the camera while holding a black cosmetic tube. (2) Close-up shot on a light wood tabletop displaying several high-end cosmetic items including a gold compact, a pink YSL cushion, a black Chanel compact, and a black NARS compact. (3) The woman holds the black Cle de Peau tube, demonstrating its texture on her hand and then applying it to her face, which has small clips holding her hair back. (4) Close-up of the woman applying a pink YSL cushion foundation with a black puff, showing the radiant finish on her cheek. (5) She holds a gold Elegance powder compact, showing the multi-colored pressed powder inside and applying it with a puff to her nose and chin. (6) Close-up of a Chanel eyeshadow palette being opened and swatched on her arm, followed by her applying the shades to her eyelids with a brush. (7) She presents a NARS blush compact, showing the pink powder inside and applying it to her cheeks with a fluffy brush. (8) The woman stands in the room, holding up a beige multi-compartment makeup organizer bag, showing its different sections to the camera.
